data.description:
## Description

**What**: Add the `review.verifier_enabled` feature flag (default false), configurable failure threshold, cascading-failure brake, and telemetry emission to both CI and local dispatch paths.

**Why**: The verifier must be off by default to allow per-project opt-in after fixture validation. Failure handling must prevent the verifier from becoming a blocking dependency. Telemetry enables observability and the review-stats calibration program.

**Scope**:
- IN: `dso-config.conf` config keys (`review.verifier_enabled`, `review.verifier_failure_threshold`, `review.verifier_strict_after`); flag check at both CI and local entry points; failure-rate tracking; cascading-failure brake (counter hold when threshold exceeded AND finding count ≥ 5); telemetry emission (confirm/downgrade/drop counts, failure rate, fingerprints[], minor-finding rate) in per-review output and review-stats; exception handling in dispatch wrapper (never blocks record-review.sh)
- OUT: Verifier agent rubric (S3), reviewer agent updates (S2), dispatch wiring (S4, S5)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `review.verifier_enabled` config key (default `false`) gates verifier dispatch at both CI and local entry points; when disabled, pipeline behaves identically to pre-epic state; verified by replaying the corpus with flag off and confirming pre-epic ruling distribution
  ← Satisfies: "Feature flag review.verifier_enabled (default false) gates verifier dispatch at both CI and local entry points"
- When this story is complete, `review.verifier_failure_threshold` (default 0.30, range validated to reject values outside (0.0, 1.0]) — failures above threshold escalate review to user attention via a distinguishable PR comment label
  ← Satisfies: "review.verifier_failure_threshold (default 0.30, range (0.0, 1.0]) — failures above threshold escalate the review to user attention"
- When this story is complete, cascading-failure brake: when threshold exceeded AND in-scope-finding count ≥ 5, autonomous-resolution loop pauses for the failing findings (rule 11 attempt counter held), preventing pre-epic invalid-finding pipeline restoration under sustained CI degradation
  ← Satisfies: "Cascading-failure brake: when failure rate exceeds the threshold AND in-scope-finding count ≥ 5, the autonomous-resolution loop is also paused"
- When this story is complete, per-review confirm/downgrade/drop counts, verifier-failure rate, per-finding fingerprints, and minor-finding rate visible in (a) per-review output and (b) review-stats aggregations with new fields: `verifier_confirm_count`, `verifier_downgrade_count`, `verifier_drop_count`, `verifier_failure_rate`, `verifier_minor_finding_rate`, `verifier_fingerprints[]`
  ← Satisfies: "Telemetry: confirm/downgrade/drop counts, verifier-failure rate, per-finding fingerprints, and review-level minor-finding rate visible in per-review output and review-stats aggregations"
- When this story is complete, dispatch wrapper catches all exceptions and treats wrapper-side crashes as `verifier_status: failed` — never blocks `record-review.sh`
  ← Satisfies: "The dispatch wrapper catches all exceptions and treats wrapper-side crashes as verifier_status: failed"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Feature flag default-off path must not regress existing review pipeline — both flag=true and flag=false paths need integration coverage

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, verifier dispatch is gated by a feature flag with configurable failure thresholds, cascading-failure brake, and review-stats telemetry
